'''Duumas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. Circa [[1002 BBY]], Duumas foretold the coming of the powerful child [[Caeleb]] [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] to create a spot devoid of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] for the boy to live at.

==Biography==
Duumas was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]<ref name="Dates" /> and attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> Around [[1002 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Duumas uncovered a prophecy foretelling the coming of a "Child of Light," a being with access to unlimited power in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Following this revelation, Duumas [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself on the sparsely-populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] in [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], merging his spirit into a large and unusually-[[color]]ed [[Tree/Legends|tree]] sited on a raised knoll to create a fifty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius protective bubble surrounding the tree that was devoid of the Force.<ref name="Child of Light" />

Nearly one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="Child of Light" /> circa [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male Caeleb, the [[Youngling/Legends|child]] heralded by Duumas, was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]. Though unaware of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master, [[Caeleb's father]] experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of Duumas' tree and Caeleb's parents settled in a homestead next to the tree with their son, the Force bubble created by Duumas shielding Caeleb from his Force power as the boy grew up.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jedi Master Duumas was mentioned in ''[[Child of Light]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Lee Pickler]] and set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that was published by [[RPGA]] in [[2000]] as the opening instalment of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]] roleplaying trilogy. The adventure does not specify Duumas' [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Child of Light" />
